blockers.finding: A9 is a structural sibling in the already-adjudicated washout x flow-stress compound basin and is dominated by its own family's validated representative. The R1 compound gauntlet (research/ORACLE_COMPOUND_GAUNTLET_R1.md, results table lines 39-41 and 'Next step' line 116) subjected A9 alongside A15/A17 and concluded 'A9 remains a secondary, weaker candidate'; A15_WASHOUT_OPP_OUT_2NODE was taken forward and now sits in the validated set (research/ORACLE_REVERSION_VALIDATED.md lines 11/31/51), while A9 appears nowhere in ORACLE_REVERSION_VALIDATED.md or ORACLE_REVERSION_HANDOFF.md. Re-adopting A9 re-litigates a candidate already ranked below a validated sibling within the same mechanism family.

A9's entire edge is recent-loaded and time-unstable, and the floor's era_consistent=3 masks a negative earliest era. Packet evaluation_plan.era_consistent=3 with era_dominant_direction 'pos', but the trial ledger era_direction_63d records 1999-2014='neg'. R1 gauntlet decomposition: 1999-2014 = -1.35%, dev-period (<=2019) = +0.13% (flat), holdout (>2019) = +2.27% -> verdict 'PASS (lumpy)' / 'recent-loaded' (R1 lines 40,59-61). The +1.06% pooled effect_63d is therefore a post-2019 artifact riding a flat/negative pre-2019 base, not a stable edge. The default 63d era-consistency gate (era-1 = 1999-2014) is exactly the gate the program itself flagged as structurally penalizing modern-regime edges (R1 lines 106-110); A9 sneaks a 3/4 pass with a negative era-1 but has NOT been run through the labeled modern-regime track that such a claim requires.

The stated mechanism lacks a rotation source and inverts the program's only validated flow-routing mechanism without a distinct falsifiable rationale. A9 buys a washout DURING a same-complex multi-node outflow cascade — i.e., the sink node and its complex-siblings are ALL bleeding, so no counter-flow is identified to fund the reversion. The validated/standout channel in the program is the OPPOSITE-complex case: P8 cond_b (washout x opposite-complex rollover) delivered the +1.14% increment 'in exactly the direction the operator predicted (money must have somewhere to come FROM)' (research/ORACLE_GAUNTLET_P8_RESULTS.md line 122), and A15 (opposite-complex) is described as 'capitulation with cross-complex displacement' (ORACLE_REVERSION_VALIDATED.md line 51). A9's same-complex framing has no analogous displacement mechanism; the empty decay_conditions/expected_failure_modes/falsifiers arrays in the packet mean no specific condition-of-death was pre-registered.

reviewer.best_counterargument: A9 did clear a real, pre-registered timing placebo at p=0.000 in the R1 gauntlet and passed G1 on the letter (holdout positive at +2.27%/65.4%, hit>52%, n=191>100). If the post-2020 structural break is treated as the governing regime (the same reasoning that rehabilitated A17 from a full-history FAIL to a modern-regime PASS, R1 Correction lines 79-110), then A9's negative 1999-2014 era is not disqualifying — it is expected for a modern-microstructure edge — and its recent loading is a feature, not a bug. Under a properly built modern-regime track, A9 could be a live higher-n complement to A15 (same-complex capitulation may capture whole-complex overshoot that opposite-complex rotation misses).
reviewer.minimum_fix_to_reconsider: Route A9 through the labeled modern-regime track (within-modern OOS split + modern sub-period consistency + a pre-committed ex-ante mechanism rationale for why same-complex outflow — with no counter-flow source — should mean-revert), exactly as R1 prescribed for modern-regime candidates (lines 106-110). Then re-file with populated decay_conditions/expected_failure_modes/falsifiers, a declared half-life, and a redundancy/overlap audit against the already-validated A15 (containment %) demonstrating A9 is additive rather than a subset of A15's opposite-complex fires.
reviewer.falsifier_spec: If, on a within-modern OOS holdout (fit through 2020, test 2021+), A9's same-complex-outflow washout fires do NOT beat (a) a size-matched random-timing placebo AND (b) the standalone-washout NULL baseline (P-W1: +0.45%/50.7% at 63d, ORACLE_GAUNTLET_P8_RESULTS.md line 17) AND the validated sector_signals BUY state (+1.1%/56%), the mechanism is dead — the pooled +1.06% was pre-2019-negative recency, not a same-complex capitulation edge.
